Become an International Student at UMSL
UMSL welcomes international students from more than 65 countries. We hope you will join our global community!
At UMSL, you'll experience a campus environment that ensures you feel supported throughout your educational journey. Our world-class professors offer challenging learning opportunities and provide immersive, hands-on experiences that will equip you for a successful career.
Interested in UMSL?
Fill out the request for information form we'll make sure you receive information about programs, tuition, scholarships, financial aid, deadlines and much more.
Already Admitted?
All undergraduate international students are required to attend Global Triton Weekend orientation.
Review orientation dates and other important information for admitted students. Learn More About International Students at UMSL

International Student and Support Services
Have questions about your immigration status, travel, employment, or adjusting to life at UMSL? ISSS is here to support international students throughout their journey. From immigration advising and cultural adjustment to campus resources and cross-cultural programs, our team is committed to helping you feel informed, supported, and connected at UMSL.
Browse our Services
Residential Life and Housing
UMSL offers multiple, conveniently located and safe on-campus living options for a variety of students. All living options include amenities such as on-site staff to assist you in feeling right at home. What’s more, all students receive a free membership at UMSL’s state-of-the-art Recreation and Wellness Center.
Residential Life and Housing
Student Life
From concerts to comedy, Triton Athletics to intramural sports, homecoming traditions to the annual Mirth Day carnival and music festival, you’ll find that UMSL offers countless opportunities to get involved, make new friends, take in a show AND just have fun.
Student Life
Honors College
UMSL's Pierre Laclede Honors College offers an enhanced student experience that is open to every undergraduate major. Choosing UMSL Honors College offers you a closer level of involvement in an even smaller, tighter-knit community where you’ll have expanded research and internship opportunities, writing and discussion-intensive courses, post-graduation preparation and one-on-one mentoring from professors who know your name and your story.
Honors College
St. Louis
No matter your interests, St. Louis is home to unique neighborhoods, parks, restaurants, sports teams, concert venues and more that you'll grow to love and where you'll make memories for a lifetime.
Life in St. Louis
Elevating Higher Education:
Connecting Locally and Globally with University Partners and STL Mosaic
University Partners
The Global Partnerships team strategically provides assistance in expanding and developing partnership opportunities. This support aims to help the University of Missouri–St. Louis further establish itself as a leader in global education.
STL Mosaic
The University of Missouri–St. Louis, assists incoming international students undergo a transition to life in St. Louis and on campus facilitated by the UMSL Mosaic Ambassadors program. Learn more about our partnership with STL Mosaic.
